actionable_steps.citation: Food, the heart and the mind — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-01-21
actionable_steps.step: Observe moderation in food habits, work, and sleep — 'Be always moderate, never indulge in excess.'

actionable_steps.citation: Food, the heart and the mind — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-01-21
actionable_steps.step: Regulate food habits — wholesome balanced food with low fat; avoid worry, hurry, and curry (fatty foods), the root causes of cardiac ailments.

actionable_steps.citation: Health, diet and Divinity — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-06-03
actionable_steps.step: Exercise self-restraint, regulate your habits, and bear the three P's — Purity, Patience, Perseverance — the royal road to good health and bliss.
Develop human values and help ever, hurt never — with human values developed, you can be free from diseases.

actionable_steps.citation: Unity is our life breath — SSS Vol 31 (1998), 1998-11-20
actionable_steps.step: Do not bestow undue attention on your health — discharge your duties peacefully and happily, and everything will be alright.
Wake at dawn, clean your mouth well, take proper sleep, and play games and sports with joy.

definition.quote: HEALTH is an essential requisite of man... The scriptures proclaim that health is the very root of all endeavour in the four fields of human achievement - Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha (righteousness, wealth, desire and liberation).

discourses.citation: Unity is our life breath — SSS Vol 31 (1998), 1998-11-20
discourses.quote: Health is very essential in order to do so. In fact, health is the very foundation on which human life rests. If health is lost, you have to suffer in many ways. There is no greater wealth than health.

discourses.citation: Health, diet and Divinity — SSS Vol 28 (1995), 1995-06-03
discourses.quote: For every man two things are essential: Arogya (good health) and Anandha (Happiness). Health for the body and bliss for the spirit. With these two wings you can soar to any height.

discourses.citation: Food, the heart and the mind — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-01-21
discourses.quote: It is essential to observe the principle of moderation in food habits, work and sleep. In fact, moderation is the royal road to happiness.
Virtue is the panacea for both body and mind. The virtuous person can be both healthy and happy. A sound mind needs a sound body; the one reacts on the other.

make_it_real: Health is the foundation everything stands on — eat moderately, sleep well, worry less, and use the body He gave you to serve.
title: Health

vahinis.quote: The spiritual aspirant must always possess contentment. What does this mean? It implies contentment under all conditions, good health or illness, loss or profit, grief or joy. Whether one's wish is fulfilled or not, the mind should not lose equanimity and poise.
